class.name: GenericVehicleComponent
class.description: Generic VehicleComponent This class allows to implement a custom VehicleComponent in GDScript. You need to implement [code]_get_component_state()[/code] returning a [Dictionary] of the actual state of this component. You also need to implement [code]_process_component(delta)[/code] if you need to compute a custom behaviour of this component. The vehicle calls it on every tick while the component is enabled.
